research_question: Across every whole-cent Polymarket US price and every integer quantity from one through one thousand contracts, what exact cash rounding uplift can the exchange-wide maker rebate create, and can it ever exceed the rounded taker fee or create a standalone public profit floor?

chronology.discovery_status: The official fee formula, coefficients, and banker-rounding rule were viewed during mechanism discovery before this contract.
chronology.admissible_use: Because the audit exhausts the full frozen price and quantity grid without selecting a market, price, size, or row after observation, it may establish only the deterministic fee identity and exact positive realized-receipt overlay. It cannot establish fill probability, current market applicability, eligibility, execution, capacity, or standalone profit.
chronology.no_cherry_picking: Every 0.01 through 0.99 price and every one through one thousand whole-contract quantity is included. Extrema use deterministic tie-breaking by smaller quantity then lower price.

official_source.claim: Effective exchange-wide from April 3, 2026, fees use theta times contracts times price times one minus price; taker theta is 0.05, maker-rebate theta is 0.0125, the maker rebate is applied at trade, and fees and rebates round to the nearest cent with round-half-to-even. The separately dated taker-rebate promotion is excluded.

fee_identity.formula: absolute fee or rebate USD = theta * integer contract quantity * price * (1 - price)

acceptance_invariants: at least one combination has a positive rounded maker rebate
zero combinations have positive maker rebate while rounded taker fee is zero
zero combinations have rounded maker rebate greater than rounded taker fee
maximum positive rounding uplift is no more than half a cent per trade
maximum effective maker share of rounded taker fee is no more than one half
limitations: A rebate is incremental cash on an independently justified organic maker fill, not a profitable reason to create the trade.

The public source does not prove account or jurisdiction eligibility, market minimum quantity, fill grouping, partial-fill rounding cadence, queue position, fill probability, capacity, or owned receipt.
Adverse selection, inventory, hedge, cancellation, spread, latency, settlement, capital, tax, and operating costs can exceed the rebate and every rounding uplift.
Do not split orders or fills to optimize rounding, manufacture volume or fills, self-trade, wash-trade, spoof, manipulate, use related accounts, or otherwise abuse fee or incentive rules.
Any account request, credential use, order, cancellation, fund movement, or transaction requires explicit separate authority.
retry_policy: This exact official fee-page GET and exhaustive grid are one-use. Preserve any source or schema failure without alias or retry. A passing result may accept only exact positive USD maker rebate actually credited on an independently justified legitimate organic Polymarket US maker fill after every incremental cost; it never proves standalone strategy profit, current account eligibility, fill quality, capacity, recurrence, or deployment readiness.
